description: Which x402 API should I call? Describe a task in plain words (need=) and get the 1-5 best paid APIs, one per seller, ranked by proven demand (30-day unique payers, repeat buyers, scanners excluded). Each pick is checked live (answers 402 now, live price, latency) and comes with its invocation example, reason codes, risk flags and a cheaper proven alternative. Whole CDP Bazaar. Each pick has match_strength and a ready request (GET URL or POST body); view=compact saves tokens. No picks = 404, not charged. Free demo: GET /recommend/demo?need=web search (or crypto prices, weather). Price: $0.008 USDC per call, paid with x402 on Base.

maxPrice.description: Maximum price per call in USD

need.description: The task in plain words, e.g. "check if a Base token is a honeypot"
